profile.title: Profile
profile.speakingCheckDesc: Record yourself every 30 days and hear your progress

speakingCheck.recordSubtitle: Look at these 4 pictures and talk about them in English for 1 minute.
speakingCheck.firstTitle: No check yet — do your first one today
speakingCheck.firstText: Your first check is just a starting point. It's fine to say only a little. Come back in 30 days and hear how much more you can say.
speakingCheck.earlyNote: You can record early, but you only get XP when a check is due (every 30 days).
speakingCheck.how1: Look at the same 4 pictures (always the same set, so you can compare).
speakingCheck.how2: Tap record and talk about the pictures in English for 1 minute. Stuck? Just move on — mistakes are fine.
speakingCheck.how3: We count words per minute, phrases you used and long pauses, and keep your voice to compare with your first try.
speakingCheck.privacy: Your recordings stay in this browser on this device. They're never uploaded (clearing site data or changing devices removes them). Turning speech into text uses Google / Microsoft, like the “Say it” button.
speakingCheck.storeError: This browser won't let us save recordings (for example, private mode). You can still record and see results, but they won't be kept.
speakingCheck.promptsTitle: Not sure what to say? Try these questions
speakingCheck.startHint: Tap record when you're ready. You have 1 minute — keep talking, one picture at a time.
speakingCheck.notSupported: This browser can't record sound. Try Chrome or Edge.
speakingCheck.noTranscribe: This browser can't turn speech into text. You can still record and count pauses, but there won't be words per minute (Chrome or Edge gives you everything).
speakingCheck.recordFailed: Couldn't start recording. Try again, or use Chrome / Edge.
speakingCheck.tooShort: This one wasn't saved. Try to talk a little longer — even naming things you see, one by one, is great.
speakingCheck.doneXp: +{{xp}} XP — come back in 30 days for the next check.
speakingCheck.doneEarly: This was an extra recording (no XP). Next check: {{date}}
speakingCheck.saveError: Couldn't save the recording, so it won't be in your history.
speakingCheck.vsPrevious: Small numbers = change since last time ({{date}})
speakingCheck.vsFirst: Latest check — small numbers = change since your first one
speakingCheck.noText: We couldn't turn this one into text, so there are no word counts (you can still listen and see pauses).
speakingCheck.statsNote: Numbers come from speech-to-text, which can miss words. Listening to your own recordings side by side shows the most.
speakingCheck.sampleTitle: How a native speaker tells it
speakingCheck.sampleHint: Listen and compare with what you said. It doesn't have to match — your own words are great.
speakingCheck.compareHint: Play these one after the other and hear how much smoother you sound.
speakingCheck.milestonesHint: Counted from your first check. Tap a goal to practice it.

collection.emptyAll: No cards yet. Say phrases right in the phrase library and your cards will show up here.
collection.empty: No cards here yet. Go collect some!

settings.title: Settings
settings.thaiReadingHint: Auto = hidden in Stages 1–5, shown in Stages 6–7 (Stages 1–3 show no text at all)
settings.translationHint: Keep it hidden so you can guess from the picture and sound first.
settings.voiceHint: Lesson words and sentences use a ready-made high-quality native voice (works offline). This choice is for sentences without a ready-made file. Voices named Natural or Google usually sound best.
settings.micPrivacy: The “Say it” button uses your browser's speech listening. Chrome and Edge send what you say to Google / Microsoft servers to turn it into text, so it needs the internet. This site doesn't record or keep your voice from this button. (Speaking Check on your profile keeps recordings on this device only, so you can compare them.)
settings.voiceFallbackNote: The online voice isn't working right now (maybe no internet), so the on-device voice “{{name}}” is used. It will switch back when you're online.
settings.dailyGoalHint: How many minutes a day? Today's plan is made to fit.
settings.speechRateHint: Used for sound that plays by itself and for speaker buttons. The “Listen” and “Slow” buttons still let you choose each time (Shadow Karaoke and Word Swap Race always use normal speed).
settings.backupHint: Your progress lives only in this browser. Save it to a file in case you clear the browser or change devices (settings and Speaking Check recordings are not included).
settings.backupSaved: Your backup is downloading. Keep it somewhere safe.
settings.restoreConfirm: Replace your progress with this file?
settings.restoreFrom: This file was saved on {{date}}. Your current progress and review list will be replaced.
settings.restoreNoDate: Your current progress and review list will be replaced.
settings.restoreInvalid: This isn't a backup from this site, or the file is damaged. Your progress hasn't changed.
settings.restoreNewer: This file comes from a newer version of the site. Refresh this page and try again.
settings.resetHint: Clear your progress and learn from the beginning (settings stay the same).
settings.resetWarning: XP, level, streak, finished lessons, phrase cards, room, friendships and your review list will be gone. You can't undo this. Not sure? Save to a file first.
settings.resetRecordings: Also delete my Speaking Check recordings
settings.resetDone: Fresh start! Ready when you are.
settings.resetRecordingsFailed: Progress cleared, but Speaking Check recordings couldn't be deleted. Try deleting them on the Speaking Check page.
settings.effectsHint: Little sounds when you get it right, get a card, level up or unlock something, plus small movements on screen.

welcome.title: Welcome to English Town
welcome.subtitle: 3 things to know before you start

native.title: Learn like a native child
native.text: Native kids listen for a long time, then speak, read and write. Lessons here follow that order in 7 stages. Finish one stage to open the next.

guess.title: Listen, look, and guess
guess.text: At first there are no words to read. Listen and look at the picture. You remember better than when you translate.
guess.picture: Always guess from the picture and sound first. You don’t need every word.
guess.meaning: Want the Thai meaning? You can tap to see it any time.
guess.mistakes: Mistakes are fine. No lives to lose — you hear the right way, then try again.

daily.title: Get your mic ready, and learn a little every day
daily.text: Tap "Continue" on the home page. It always takes you to your next lesson.
daily.mic: Use Chrome or Edge, and allow the microphone when asked (Safari on iPhone does not hear speech well).
daily.daily: 5–20 minutes every day beats one long session. Your streak counts the days.
daily.review: Missed items come back for review. If you see "Review today", do it first.

npc.chats: Things to talk about — closer friends share more
npc.howToFriend: Finish random talks with {{name}} to get closer and unlock new chats.

welcomeBack.title: Welcome back
welcomeBack.note: You were away for {{days}} days. Let's keep going!
welcomeBack.noteReview: You were away for {{days}} days. Warm up with a quick review.
